standard-dialogue.npc: Well, hello again Traveller! How are you?

standard-dialogue.player: I'm good thanks, how's the tree?

standard-dialogue.npc: Better than ever, thanks to you!

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.npc: Adventurer! It is good to see you again.

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.player: And you too, King. How fares the tree?

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.npc: The tree? It is fine, as it has always been since we foiled Glough's plans.

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.player: Good. What ever did happen to Glough?

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.npc: Oh, I forced him to resign. I have now appointed a new Head Tree Guardian, Daero. He is learning quickly and serves me well.

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.player: King, you look worried. Is anything the matter?

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.npc: Nothing in particular ... Well actually, yes - there is.
Well, do you remember Glough's ship building facilities in Karamja?

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.player: Yes, they were on the eastern coast. What of them?

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.npc: After you defeated Glough's demon I sent an envoy of my Royal Guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommission of the shipyard. They were ordered to use force if necessary.
I ... I don't know. I have heard nothing from them. I do not even know if they reached the shipyard!
But I need to know what happened. These are elite soldiers - their disappearance cannot simply be ignored. I cannot wait any longer.
And so I ask you: would you visit Glough's old shipyard in Karamja and find out if the 10th squad ever managed to reach?

before-starting-monkey-madness-i.prompt: Start the Monkey Madness I quest?

steps.text: Narnode hands you a copy of the Royal Seal.

steps.npc: Thank you very much. You may need this Royal Seal to identify yourself as my envoy.
Please report to me as soon as you have any information.

steps.player: I'm afraid I am too busy right now.

steps.npc: As you wish. Return to me when you have the time.

after-monkey-madness-i.npc: Good of you to stop by, human.
Everything seems fine, as far as I can tell... I will let you know if there is any trouble.

after-monkey-madness-i.text: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Monkey Madness II quest.

after-completing-monkey-madness-ii.npc: Good to see you again, [player name].

options.text: Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?

steps.player: Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?

steps.npc: All is well in the Stronghold thanks to you, [player name].

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to King Narnode
If the player does have a reward token available:
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
If the player has an unclaimed reward token:
Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
If the player has claimed their reward token:

gnome-restaurant.text: If the player ran out of time:

steps.text: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
